scope: Native whole-answer diagnostic screen only; not SDK/device acceptance
observer: none; uninstrumented System allocator, no perf/strace in timing windows
aggregation: retain all 150 windows; per-scene median and full range of CPU and wall time, E-relative ratios; no silent retries/replacement or automatic acceptance
limitations: Whole process includes fixture setup and 800 priming answers. It is not a daemon/network load or physical router measurement.
host-localise uses the unchanged process-address-dependent name hash mixer; preserve variability, do not force a favorable seed.
Raw configured address records and synthetic/localised/lease cases are compatibility and regression controls; they do not justify bypassing those paths.
